[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Aytuur Odock''' was a [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] by the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]. Ayturr wrote a personal journal whilst assisting with an archaeological expedition into the [[Temple of the Progenitor]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], where they expressed their gratitude to one of the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] archaeologists, [[Taasi]], for showing them so much about ancient Selkath culture.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Temple of the Progenitor}}</ref>
